FROM python:3.12-slim

ENV PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1 \
    PYTHONUNBUFFERED=1 \
    PIP_NO_CACHE_DIR=1

WORKDIR /app

COPY wiki_tools/requirements.txt ./wiki_tools/requirements.txt
RUN pip install --upgrade pip \
    && pip install -r wiki_tools/requirements.txt

COPY wiki_tools ./wiki_tools

# Volumes are mounted at runtime: /app/outputs (ro), /app/raw (ro), /app/wiki (rw).
CMD ["python", "-m", "wiki_tools.ingest"]
